frequency_question: What proportion of administrative mandates with tight sub-30-day deadlines achieve formal gazette notification or final published rules within the allotted calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal executive or regulatory directive where a supreme judicial or legislative body mandates completion of a finalized rule within 30 days or fewer. Excludes voluntary guidelines or timelines exceeding 30 days.

cases.name: 2019 Supreme Court Air Quality Emergency Directive compliance
2023 Digital Personal Data Protection Rules preliminary draft window

coverage_note: 4 named instances representing the class of extreme compressed-timeline judicial mandates in federal regulatory practice; estimated total population is roughly 10-15 such extreme orders over the past decade.
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative clarifications that do not require formal statutory gazette notification or inter-ministerial consultation.
skeleton: Emergency executive orders requiring multi-departmental rule finalization under compressed judicial deadlines
multiplier: 1 hit out of 4 documented instances of sub-30-day administrative finalization mandates
validity_reason: Bureaucratic procedure laws and inter-ministerial consultation frameworks remain structurally stable across administrative terms.
